q: There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.
What you become is far more important than what you get.
Your life does not get better by chance, it gets better by change.
There is no path to Happiness. Happiness is the path.
We all give up great expectations along the way.
The big secret in life is that there is no big secret. Whatever your goal, you can get there if you're willing to work.
The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
The future is no more uncertain than the present.
The wisest men follow their own direction.
If you do not conquer self, you will be conquered by self.
When you view failure as feedback, you get more done. When you view failure as a finality, you get nothing done.
FEAR has two meanings: 'Forget Everything And Run' or 'Face Everything And Rise.' The choice is yours.
Be happy now, without reason - or you never will be at all.
Pleasure is always derived from something outside you, whereas joy arises from within.
Throughout this life, you can never be certain of living long enough to take another breath.
Passion creates, addiction consumes.
It's okay to be discouraged. It's not okay to quit.
Out of your vulnerabilities will come your strength.
The first rule of handling conflict is don't hang around people who are constantly engaging in conflict.
The constant assertion of belief is an indication of fear.
Even in the grave, all is not lost.
Wisdom is doing now what you are going to be happy with later on.
If you done it, it ain't bragging.
We can't help everyone, but everyone can help someone.
Our truest life is when we are in dreams awake.
A man who acquires the ability to take full possession of his own mind may take possession of anything else to which he is justly entitled.
If you see someone without a smile give them one of yours.
Take interest and even delight in doing the small things well.
I am always doing what I cannot do yet, in order to learn how to do it.
Where you are right now doesn't have to determine where you'll end up.
In all chaos there is a cosmos, in all disorder a secret order.
Great things are not accomplished by those who yield to trends and fads and popular opinion.
It is in the darkness that one finds the light.
Let us always meet each other with smile, for the smile is the beginning of love.
Opportunities don't often come along. So, when they do, you have to grab them.
One loyal friend is worth ten thousand relatives.
First comes the shy wish. Then you must have the heart to have the dream. Then, you work, and work.
A life spent making mistakes is not only more honorable but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.
Life is about not knowing and then doing something anyway.
If you aren't sure which way to do something, do it both ways and see which works better.
Failure is the highway to success.
Make each day a new horizon.
A liar knows that he is a liar, but one who speaks mere portions of truth in order to deceive is a craftsman of destruction.
Life is a balance of holding on and letting go.
Death and life have their determined appointments; riches and honors depend upon heaven.
Sometimes things become possible if we want them bad enough.
If you are depressed, you are living in the past. If you are anxious, you are living in the future. if you are at peace, you are living in the present.
Get busy living, or get busy dying.
To some degree, you control your life by controlling your time.
